Name: Tanga's Forest Buildings Refreshed
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Paint mask support for 13 buildings (customize colors!)[/*]
[*]Animated elements will bring your farm to life[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) farm building support[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Buildings Included ✧ [/size][/b]
[b][color=#c9daf8]New Buildings ✧[/color][/b] (7)
[list]
[*]SVE Premium Barn[/*]
[*]SVE Premium Coop[/*]
[*]SVE Winery[/*]
[*]Fish Pond[/*]
[*]Junimo Hut[/*]
[*]Mailbox[/*]
[*]Shipping Bin[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#c9daf8]Original Tanga Farm Buildings ✧[/color][/b] (19)
[list]
[*]Barn, Big Barn, Deluxe Barn[/*]
[*]Coop, Big Coop, Deluxe Coop[/*]
[*]Shed, Big Shed[/*]
[*]Stable[/*]
[*]Mill[/*]
[*]Silo (new design)[/*]
[*]Greenhouse[/*]
[*]Well[/*]
[*]Slime Hutch[/*]
[*]Gold Clock[/*]
[*]Farmhouse[/*]
[*]Log Cabin[/*]
[*]Stone Cabin[/*]
[*]Plank Cabin (small tweak)[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Paint Mask Support ✧ [/size][/b]
The following buildings now support custom painting (Walls/Roof/Trim colors):
[list]
[*]Big Shed[/*]
[*]Deluxe Barn[/*]
[*]Deluxe Coop[/*]
[*]Stable[/*]
[*]Shed (Animated)[/*]
[*]Slime Hutch (Animated)[/*]
[*]House (upgrade level 3+ only)[/*]
[*]Log Cabin[/*]
[*]Plank Cabin[/*]
[*]Stone Cabin[/*]
[*]Premium Barn (SVE)[/*]
[*]Premium Coop (SVE)[/*]
[*]Winery (SVE)[/*]
[/list][i]Note: I’m stuck on letting players paint other buildings (like the mill). I have paint masks for those buildings and can open the paint menu, but the paint won’t apply. This may require a C# solution, and I'll probably look into that later myself. But if anyone’s cracked this for the coop, barn, big coop, big barn, mill, or silo, I’d love to hear how you did it!

[/i][b][size=3]✧ Animations ✧ [/size][/b]
Added animation to Golden Clock, Well, Slime Hutch, and Shed (not pictured)
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41878/41878-1770047930-664142410.gif[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41878/41878-1770047930-732784494.gif[/img]

[b][size=3]✧ Other Visual Updates ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Redrawn Silo (hay basket design, removed shadow)[/*]
[*]Tweaked Mill visuals (minor adjustments)[/*]
[*]Spring flowers changed to pink (to differentiate from summer's yellow)[/*]
[*]Adjusted door for Small Slime Hutch[/*]
[*]Adjusted door and window for Plank Cabin[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Compatability ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246][b]Alternative Textures[/b][/url] (Pack in optional files)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url] (Enable/disable buildings, may require visit to title to refresh)[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43704]Magical Broomstick[/url][/b] includes a Tanga-style Broom Closet building![/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Requirements ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (v2.9.0+)[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Technical Details ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Disabling/Enabling animated buildings may require visiting Title to refresh.[/*]
[*]Applying AT on animated buildings may create undesired visual effects[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Credits & Permissions ✧ [/size][/b]
Artwork [url=https://i.imgur.com/ZJ7STvc.png]used with permission[/url] from Tanga. I've had the privilege of updating Tanga's buildings code in the past, and enjoy permission to post her artwork under her name. So grateful to Tanga to be able to maintain these buildings in her name and keep them accessible for everyone.
Original mods were [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16852]Tangas forest Buildings[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16853]Tangas forest Gold Clock[/url]. Tanga may, of course, share these files to Naver as she sees fit!
